verbatim_quote.original: If you need repo data first, return a discovery task instead of a plan.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: If you need repo data first, return a discovery task instead of a plan.

extracted_decision.summary: Manager permits returning a discovery task instead of an implementation plan when repository data is needed first.
extracted_decision.rationale: To avoid producing a plan grounded in assumptions rather than verified repository state.
alternatives: Require an implementation plan immediately despite missing repo data
Proceed with assumptions and revise later
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Delays planning but reduces risk of an incorrect architecture; May require an extra discovery round
